sources.citation: Yaara Yeshurun, Mai Nguyen, Uri Hasson (2021). The default mode network: where the idiosyncratic self meets the shared social world. Nature Reviews Neuroscience.
sources.notes: Synthesizes modern systems-neuroscience evidence that the Default Mode Network actively integrates autobiographical memory, narrative meaning, and social sense-making.
